title: New Moon in Capricorn
tldr: A seed point for structure, ambition, responsibility, boundaries, time, and the legacy built through real effort.
theme: Capricorn is a cardinal earth sign ruled traditionally by Saturn. This New Moon begins work around structure, ambition, responsibility, boundaries, time, and the legacy built through real effort.
shadow: achievement at the cost of humanity, measuring worth only by output, or choosing success over softness
integration: building something durable without abandoning the life it is meant to support

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc reveals where success was chosen over softness.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Capricorn; watch what the Cancer Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, oil lantern or candle, and water.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Capricorn. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through structure, ambition, responsibility, boundaries, time, and the legacy built through real effort, without repeating the shadow of achievement at the cost of humanity, measuring worth only by output, or choosing success over softness?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Capricorn intention take form?
